title: Untangle the Notification God-Class (SOLID)
summary: Refactor an if/else notification service into small notifiers behind one interface, with injected dependencies and failure isolation.
hints: One interface, three implementations. Each notifier knows its channel name, whether it can reach the user, and how to send.
`NotificationService` should only loop over the notifiers it was given. It must not mention email, SMS or push anywhere.
Skip a notifier if the user muted its channel **or** the notifier can't reach the user (missing email, phone or device token).
Wrap each send in try/catch (Java) or check the returned error (Go). One broken channel must not stop the others.
